error.not_a_ws90: That address answers Modbus, but the device is not a WS90

data_description.host: The WS90's hostname or IP address, or that of the gateway bridging it.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port of the gateway. WS90 gateways typically use 502.
data_description.unit_id: The WS90's Modbus device address, printed on the sensor as its factory default (0x90 / 144) unless changed.

user.description: Enter the address of your WS90's Modbus gateway. This is usually an RTU-over-TCP serial gateway, not the sensor speaking Modbus TCP natively.

unexpected_device.message: The device answering at this address is no longer the WS90 this entry was set up for (expected ID {unique_id}).
